title: Managed Backup: settlement precision
content:
For Managed Backup, the following tier basis defines settlement precision.

## Tier basis

**Currency.** Invoice and settlement currency; ISO currency string.

**Monetary decimal precision.** Monetary decimal places; integer.

**Meter quantity decimal precision.** Meter quantity decimal places; integer.

**Rounding convention.** Decimal tie-breaking convention for monetary and quantity rounding; string.

| Contract tier | Currency | Monetary decimal precision | Meter quantity decimal precision | Rounding convention |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB | USD | 2 | 6 | Half up, with exact halfway ties rounded away from zero |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 10 TB | USD | 2 | 6 | Half up, with exact halfway ties rounded away from zero |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 25 TB | USD | 2 | 6 | Half up, with exact halfway ties rounded away from zero |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 50 TB | USD | 2 | 6 | Half up, with exact halfway ties rounded away from zero |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 100 TB | USD | 2 | 6 | Half up, with exact halfway ties rounded away from zero |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 250 TB | USD | 2 | 6 | Half up, with exact halfway ties rounded away from zero |

## Tier lookup

For the Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB tier, currency is USD.

## Hypothetical comparison

In a hypothetical switch between any of the listed tiers, currency stays the same.
